headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth accelerated in August, while consumer inflation picked up again, amid volatile energy and commodity costs linked to the US-Israel war on Iran.
The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.
The reading beat a 3.6 per cent projection from economists polled by financial data provider Wind.

headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月份工厂出厂价格增速加快，而消费者通胀再次抬头，原因在于与美以对伊朗战争相关的能源和大宗商品成本波动。国家统计局周三发布的数据显示，上月生产者价格指数同比上涨3.8%，高于7月份的3.5%。

headlines.title_en: Midday review for September 11: Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext Index each fall more than 2%, with nearly 5,200 stocks declining across the market
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market fluctuated and adjusted in the morning, with all three major indices down about 2%. The defense sector was active in some areas, Inner Mongolia First Machinery hit the daily limit. Power stocks rose intraday, Mindong Electric had a third consecutive limit-up, Hangzhou Thermal Power and Jiangsu New Energy hit the limit. Film and media stocks rebounded from lows, China Television Media hit the limit. On the decline side, nonferrous metals and precious metals sectors adjusted sharply, Northern Copper, Western Mining, Jingyi shares and others hit the limit; semiconductor chip stocks weakened, Juguang Technology and Bright Power Semiconductor fell more than 10%. headlines.title: 汽油价格反弹可能推升美国8月CPI环比涨幅
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月11日讯，据外媒报道，由于汽油价格在连续两个月下降后反弹，美国8月消费者物价涨幅料呈加速，这将强化金融市场对美联储下周可能加息的预期。 美国劳工部周五将公布8月CPI报告。此前，周四公布的PPI报告的几个关键组成部分均表现强劲。经济学家表示，随着油价重回每桶100美元以上，通胀势必居高不下并进一步扩大。另一些经济学家则认为，由于进口关税，尤其是最近对美国主要贸易伙伴加拿大征收的关税，物价压力将持续存在。

headlines.title_en: Rebound in gasoline prices may boost the month-on-month increase in US August CPI
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 11: According to foreign media reports, as gasoline prices rebounded after two consecutive months of declines, US August consumer price growth is expected to accelerate, which would strengthen financial market expectations that the Fed may raise interest rates next week. The US Labor Department will release the August CPI report on Friday. Previously, several key components of the PPI report released on Thursday were strong. Economists said that with oil prices returning above $100 per barrel, inflation is bound to remain elevated and further broaden. Other economists believe that price pressures will persist due to import tariffs, especially the recent tariffs imposed on Canada, a major US trading partner.
